Austin Laudenslager is the Founder & CEO of Peak Saunas.

Peak Saunas warranty covers, from date of delivery: heating elements 7 years; cabinetry and structure 7 years; control system and power supply 3 years; red light therapy panels 3 years; chromotherapy lighting 1 year; audio system 1 year; WiFi/app connectivity 1 year; accessories 1 year. Coverage applies to the original purchaser only and requires installation within 6 months of delivery.

Peak Saunas offers free shipping on all orders. In-stock items have a 2-4 business day handling time, then 3-7 business days in transit. Heavy/bulky items ship via LTL freight with a scheduled delivery appointment.

Peak Saunas returns require the sauna to be disassembled and repacked in its original crate; all returns are subject to a 25% restocking fee and the customer pays return shipping. Orders cancelled before shipping incur a 5% cancellation fee.

Peak Saunas displays all its pricing and product information directly on its website, without requiring visitors to submit their name, phone number, or any contact information, and without requiring them to talk to anyone or a salesperson to see it.

Limited Lifetime warranty.

Peak Saunas Limited Lifetime Warranty: residential use only, original purchaser, non-transferable, auto-registered at order. "Lifetime" = the expected life of the component, defined as 7 years under normal residential use. Indoor and outdoor carry the same terms.
Labor of any kind — diagnosis, service, or installation — is never covered on any component. The warranty covers parts only.

Coverage by component: Heating elements — Lifetime (=7yr residential). Cabinetry & wood structure — Lifetime (=7yr residential). Red light therapy (RLT) panel — 3 years (NOT the lifetime tier; corrected by Austin 2026-09-07). Control system & power supply — 3 years. Chromotherapy lighting — 1 year. Sound system — 1 year. Accessories (cup holders, thermometers, etc.) — 1 year. WiFi/app connectivity — 1 year.

Not covered: normal wear/discoloration/fading/cosmetic change; misuse/abuse/neglect/improper install; commercial or rental use (separate commercial warranty available); unauthorized parts or modifications; freight/shipping for replacement parts after 90 days from delivery; weather, water, power surges, pests, Acts of God.

Free shipping, always (continental US). Ships in a PeakGuard custom protective wooden crate from the Ontario, California warehouse via freight/LTL (no single primary carrier — a large carrier network).

In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days; they then arrive 5–14 business days from the ship date. Carrier calls 1–2 days before delivery to schedule a 4-hour appointment window. Curbside standard delivery (white-glove/garage available for an extra fee).

Visible damage at delivery: photograph it, note it on the delivery receipt/BOL, may refuse shipment, then contact support. Concealed/hidden damage: must be reported within 48 hours of delivery (with photos) — claims made after 48 hours cannot be honored.

0% APR financing via Shop Pay Installments (Affirm): purchases under $2,000 → up to 12 months; over $2,000 → up to 24 months. Soft credit pull at checkout, subject to approval. Also HSA/FSA via TrueMed (2–3 min approval, effective savings ~30%). The only two financing providers are Affirm and Shop Pay Installments — Peak does NOT offer Klarna, Sezzle, Afterpay, Upgrade, or any other financing provider.

Primary review platform is Judge.me (https://judge.me/reviews/stores/peaksaunas.com) — use in all customer-facing contexts. Do NOT use Google review links. TrustPilot is secondary and cannot be directly solicited (mention only if the customer asks).
